title: AndromedaMC
description: AndromedaMC is a Minecraft Server which consists of the following gamemodes: KitPvP, Survival, Skyblock, and Events.
body:
**AndromedaMC** is a **Minecraft Network** that consists of the following gamemodes: 

- **KitPvP**: Fight your way to the top and become the richest.
- **Survival**: Start from the bottom and make your way to the top.
- **Skyblock**: Expand and manage your resources to become the strongest.
- **Events**: Take part in fun minigames.
